decisions.reason: The resin injection unit was launched only a year ago, has its own product page and fits the firm's core plural-component expertise, so there is no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search for alternatives.

This second injection unit somewhat overlaps Product A, which carries a slight risk of consolidation, but it is a young product within the firm's core competence and its results are not yet clear enough to justify dropping it.
Automatic airless guns are a staple accessory for spray equipment makers, they produce recurring sales, and an established medium-sized firm has the slack to carry them.
A manual airless gun is a core, high-volume complement to the firm's pumps and is very likely to meet aspirations.
Air-assisted airless guns serve finishing applications within the firm's spray portfolio, and there is no sign of underperformance after one year.
The data logger lies further from the core and its results are more uncertain, but it supports the firm's innovation direction and organisational slack allows it to be carried while results develop.
